description: This Java source file defines the TreeFactory class, which is responsible for creating and managing ModelTree objects from XML resources within the OFBiz widget framework. It includes methods for loading trees from location resources and parsing XML documents to build tree models.

classes.name: TreeFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and caching ModelTree instances from XML resources, providing methods to retrieve trees by location and parse XML documents.

methods.name: getTreeFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelTree object from a specified resource location and tree name, loading and caching the XML document if necessary.

methods.name: readTreeDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to construct a map of ModelTree objects based on 'tree' elements within the document.
